orca worktree set

Usage: orca worktree set --worktree <selector> [--display-name <name>] [--issue <number|null>] [--linear-issue <identifier-or-url|null>] [--comment <text>] [--workspace-status <id>] [--parent-worktree <selector>|--no-parent] [--json]

Update Orca metadata for a worktree

Options:
  --help                 Show this help message
  --json                 Emit machine-readable JSON
  --pairing-code
  --environment
  --worktree <selector>  Worktree selector such as identity:<identity>, id:<repo-id>::<path>, name:<displayName>, branch:<branch>, issue:<number>, path:<path>, or active/current
  --display-name <name>  Override the Orca display name
  --issue <number|null>  Linked GitHub issue number
  --linear-issue <id|url|null> Linked Linear issue identifier or URL; null clears on set
  --comment <text>       Comment stored in Orca metadata
  --workspace-status <id> Board status id (defaults: todo, in-progress, in-review, completed)
  --parent-worktree <selector> Parent worktree selector such as identity:<identity>, id:<repo-id>::<path>, branch:<branch>, issue:<number>, path:<path>, or active/current
  --no-parent            Force no parent lineage for unrelated work

Notes:
  Workspace status ids match the board columns (defaults: todo, in-progress, in-review, completed); custom statuses use their configured id.
  Pass --linear-issue null to clear the Linear issue link.

Examples:
  $ orca worktree set --worktree active --linear-issue STA-335 --json
  $ orca worktree set --worktree active --linear-issue null --json
